jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Payments Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ziina is looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team. We laid a strong foundation upon which we’ve shipped our product. We are looking for someone to help us build out innovative new features, prepare our technology to scale, and help shape our engineering organization to be the kind of place that bright minds from across the region and the world aspire to work for.

As our team is small, our ideal candidate is a creative thinker excited to solve hard problems and to build something from the ground up. They can move quickly, clearly articulate tradeoffs, and have the judgement to own features independently. They are obsessive about delivering great, high quality products to our users. We are ambitious and excited to build big things, and we’d love to bring on someone who is as well. In short, we are looking for owners.

 

As a Backend Engineer at Ziina you will:

  • Collaborate with world-class product, design, operations, and engineering teams to determine which features and solutions will deliver the most value for the business and the best experience for our users

  • Own and ship end-to-end reliable, scalable, and maintainable software that will keep our users’ funds safe and stand the test of time. You will take features from design, to implementation, to polish, to shipping, to monitoring and measuring progress

  • Design and build a cloud-native platform while leveraging the main features for monitoring, observability, security, scalability, elasticity, and testing

  • Improve CI/CD workflows to reduce time-to-market for new features

  • Help shape our engineering culture by introducing good practices and methods of knowledge-sharing

Key skills and characteristics

  • Be an owner and a team player

  • Be curious and eager to grow

  • Be able to define and effectively communicate technical and design requirements

  • Be able to write clean, high-quality, testable, reusable, and well-documented code

  • Possess strong data-driven thinking and customer focus

  • Possess excellent communication skills and a desire to collaborate

  • Live in, or be willing to relocate to the UAE

What would amaze us

  • 3+ years developing software

  • Experience working on systems that handle money

  • Experience with Node.js, GraphQL, Postgres, ElasticSearch, or Kafka

  • Experience shipping and maintaining complex backends

Our tech stack

We’ve built a modular architecture with the principles of reliability, scalability, and maintainability in mind. Our current stack is:

  • Typescript, Node.js and Nest.js for our main application’s backend

  • Swift/SwiftUI for our iOS app, Kotlin for our Android app

  • Next.js, React and Typescript for our web applications

  • GraphQL Federation for our client-facing APIs and Kafka for our inter-service communication

  • PostgresSQL for consistent and durable storage, Redis for quick fetching, Elasticsearch for quick searching

  • AWS for hosting our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes for orchestrating our workloads

  • Terraform for IaC

  • Github Actions for CI/CD

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Ziina is searching for a dynamic Head of Marketing to lead our strategic product-led growth initiatives. This includes product marketing, brand awareness, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.

This role is ideal for a data-driven, creative leader who can develop and execute impactful marketing strategies while inspiring a high-performing team. We are seeking a versatile marketing leader with a full-stack background, with deep expertise in product marketing—including positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution—while also combining creative flair with analytical acumen to position Ziina as the go-to payments solution in the region. The ideal candidate should have a track record of success in both startup environments and scaling organizations.

This is simultaneously a hands-on role while leading a phenomenal team of passionate high performers. We expect this role to lead by example by rolling their sleeves up and diving into the details including how every pixel aligns on the latest ad.

As a Head of Marketing at Ziina you will:

  • Own product positioning and messaging strategy, translating Ziina's payment features into compelling customer benefits that drive adoption and differentiate us in the fintech market.

  • Lead comprehensive go-to-market execution for new product launches, coordinating cross-functional teams and establishing measurable success metrics for user adoption and retention.

  • Build data-driven quarterly marketing roadmaps aligned with company growth objectives, including strategic budget allocation across channels and initiatives.

  • Drive multi-channel customer acquisition through paid media, content marketing, social media, and partnership strategies while optimizing for healthy CAC payback periods.

  • Establish and maintain marketing analytics frameworks to continuously optimize campaign performance, forecast business impact, and inform strategic decision-making.

  • Craft Ziina's brand narrative and storytelling that positions us as the go-to payments solution in the region through high-quality, creative content.

  • Build and lead a high-performing marketing team, providing coaching, setting clear goals, and fostering a culture of excellence, creativity, and data-driven results.

  • Facilitate seamless cross-functional collaboration with product, sales, and executive teams to ensure alignment on messaging, goals, and strategic initiatives.

  • Conduct customer research and competitive analysis to inform product positioning, messaging frameworks, and marketing strategies that resonate with target audiences.

  • Manage marketing budgets strategically, allocating resources across channels and campaigns to achieve maximum ROI and sustainable, scalable growth.

  • Oversee creative asset development with strong aesthetic vision, ensuring all marketing materials maintain brand consistency and premium quality standards.

  • Select and manage external vendor relationships, including agencies and consultants, while maintaining high delivery standards and alignment with marketing objectives.

To succeed in this role you likely have:

  • 7+ years of progressive marketing experience with a proven track record of scaling growth in startup or high-growth environments, including demonstrated success in product marketing leadership roles

  • Strategic thinking beyond immediate needs, developing and implementing medium to long-term marketing strategies that scale effectively as the business grows

  • Deep go-to-market expertise, with experience driving successful product launches and scaling user adoption across multiple channels and customer segments

  • Experience in leading and inspiring teams, with strong mentorship skills and a focus on empowering team members to achieve peak performance and professional growth

  • High data fluency, with expertise in marketing analytics and a demonstrated ability to use metrics for forecasting, optimization, and strategic decision-making

  • The ability to combine creative flair with growth mindset, bringing natural aesthetic sense and innovative thinking to develop tailored marketing solutions that drive results

  • Confidence and decisiveness, comfortable pushing back when necessary and prioritizing initiatives that align with long-term brand vision and business objectives

  • Exceptional communication skills, with strong verbal and written skills that enable you to engage stakeholders and convey complex marketing concepts clearly

  • Resilience and problem-solving ability, with a proactive, organized approach to overcoming challenges and managing risks in a fast-paced environment

  • Passion for fintech innovation, with genuine excitement about shaping the future of payments in the Middle East through creative, data-driven marketing

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Ziina is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web) to join our team. We have laid a strong foundation upon which we've shipped our product. We are looking for someone to help us build engaging new features who is obsessive about delivering high quality products and can shape our engineering organization to be the kind of place that bright young minds from across the region aspire to work for.

As our team is small, our ideal candidate is a creative thinker excited to solve hard problems to build something from the ground up. They can move quickly, clearly articulate tradeoffs, and have the judgement to own features independently. They are obsessive about delivering great, high quality products to our users. We are ambitious and excited to build big things, and we’d love to bring on someone who is as well.

As a Full-Stack engineer at Ziina you will:

  • Collaborate with world-class product, design, operations, and engineering teams to determine which features and solutions will deliver the most value for the business and the best experience for our users.

  • Own, develop, and deliver end-to-end feature implementations spanning both the frontend and backend, with primary ownership of our web apps and working knowledge of the backend services it depends on. You will take features from design, to implementation, to polish, to shipping, to monitoring and measuring progress.

  • Actively participate in design discussions and collaborate with the product team to ensure web interfaces are user-friendly, intuitive, performant, and accessible, while integrating effectively with backend services and GraphQL APIs.

  • Review code and continuously level up by collaborating with other engineers on the team.

  • Help shape our engineering culture by introducing best practices, tools, and methods of knowledge-sharing for building best-in-class products.

To succeed in this role, you likely: 

  • Have 5+ years of full-stack development experience, with deeper expertise on the web/frontend side.

  • Demonstrate high integrity and a team-first mindset.

  • Take ownership and show initiative, with a strong bias toward action.

  • Thrive in bringing clarity and structure to ambiguous problems.

  • Are curious, proactive, and eager to learn and grow.

  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across teams.

  • Can define and articulate technical and design requirements.

  • Write clean, high-quality, testable, and well-documented code.

  • Think analytically, with strong data-driven decision-making and customer focus.

  • Are based in, or open to relocating to, the UAE

What would amaze us

  • Deep proficiency with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and comfort working in Node.js/Nest.js on the backend when a feature calls for it.

  • Strong eye for UI/UX craft — interaction design, performance (Core Web Vitals), accessibility, and cross-browser/device consistency.

  • Experience consuming and shaping GraphQL APIs (ideally with a Federation setup) from the client side.

  • Experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL, and comfort reading/writing backend logic when a feature requires it.

  • Strong understanding of RESTful/GraphQL APIs, web servers, application architecture, and deployment strategies.

  • A solid grasp of version control tools, preferably Git.

Our tech stack

We’ve built a modular architecture with the principles of reliability, scalability, and maintainability in mind. Our current stack is:

  • Typescript, Node.js and Nest.js for our main application’s backend.

  • Swift/SwiftUI for our iOS app, Kotlin for our Android app.

  • Next.js, React and Typescript for our web applications.

  • GraphQL Federation for our client-facing APIs and Kafka for our inter-service communication.

  • PostgresSQL for consistent and durable storage, Redis for quick fetching, Elasticsearch for quick searching.

  • AWS for hosting our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes for orchestrating our workloads.

  • Terraform for IaC

  • Github Actions for CI/CD.

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Ziina is looking for a Brand Marketing Manager to help define the future of one of the region's most loved brands.

This is a rare moment to join. Our brand strategy is being sharpened, a refresh is on the way, our consumer product is launching in full force, and the biggest campaigns in Ziina's history are ahead of us. The foundations are set. What we need now is someone who can build on them — someone who treats the brand as a system to be designed, not a queue of deliverables to be shipped.

You'll own brand initiatives from the first idea to the moment they're live in the world, and you'll be trusted with the judgment calls in between: what we say yes to, what we walk away from, and what "unmistakably Ziina" means at every touchpoint. You'll move fluidly between strategy and execution — writing the brief in the morning, reviewing the creative in the afternoon — and you'll raise the bar on both.

As a Brand Marketing Manager at Ziina you will:

  • Own brand initiatives from first idea to launch: write the brief, set the timeline, align the teams involved, and ship the work

  • Support integrated campaigns with Product Marketing, Growth, Partnerships, PR, Social, and Creative — one brief, one story, every channel

  • Keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint: review social content, campaign assets, partner materials, and in-app copy, and fix what's off

  • Work across all 7 C's: content, campaigns, creative direction and identity, culture, creators, community, and events

  • Brief and manage content creators: choose them, write the brief, review the work, and own the relationship end to end

  • Follow trends daily and decide which ones Ziina joins — then move fast when we do

  • Test ideas small before scaling them: run the experiment, read the results, then put budget behind what works

  • Build repeatable formats, templates, and playbooks so good work doesn't start from zero every time

  • Turn brand strategy into campaign concepts, content direction, and briefs that teams can execute

  • Give clear, direct feedback to designers, writers, creators, and agencies

Key skills and characteristics

  • You have 5+ years in brand marketing, with at least some of them at a startup or creative-led business where you built things rather than inherited them

  • You balance strategy and execution without treating either as beneath you — you can write the strategy doc and also notice the kerning

  • You have good taste and strong judgment: you know what "good" looks like across formats and platforms, you can explain why, and you can defend it in a room

  • You're a strong project manager: multiple workstreams, many stakeholders, moving deadlines — and the details still get handled

  • You've briefed and managed content creators and influencers, and you know how to get work that feels native to the creator and still unmistakably Ziina

  • You're culturally fluent across MENA and global internet culture, and you can tell the difference between a moment worth joining and a trend that will age badly

  • You test before you scale: you'd rather prove an idea with a small, fast experiment than bet the quarter on a hunch

  • You think in systems: when you solve a problem twice, you build the playbook so no one has to solve it a third time

  • You live in, or are willing to move to, the UAE

What would amaze us

  • You've run campaigns across both consumer and business audiences and understand how one brand can serve two worlds without diluting either

  • A proven track record of orchestrating viral moments or high-performing niche posts (for yourself or a brand), with examples

  • You’ve shown up as the voice of a brand through proactive engagement that created buzz and word of mouth

  • Experience working on a brand with a strong community or cultural presence

  • An eye for design, aesthetics, and visual storytelling (you notice details and you care about craft)

  • A portfolio or social accounts you’ve helped grow or shape

  • Practical, proven use of AI tools to scale content output (drafting variations, tightening copy, repurposing, or pulling insights), without losing voice and taste

  • A genuine interest in the intersection of culture, creativity, and technology

  • Experience in fintech, consumer apps, or fast-growing startups

  • Practical, proven use of AI tools to speed up creative workflows without compromising taste or brand quality

  • A genuine interest in the intersection of culture, creativity, and finance — and a perspective on what a Middle Eastern brand can mean to the world

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Infrastructure)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role:

Ziina is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer, Infrastructure & Developer Experience to join our team. This role is an exciting opportunity to shape the foundation that every Ziina engineer builds on: the infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability systems that keep our rapidly growing fintech platform fast, reliable, and easy to develop. We're at a major inflection point in our growth, with real multi-region and low-latency challenges at scale, and we're looking for the right person to drive the technical excellence that makes scaling possible.

As part of a small, agile team, our ideal candidate is a creative problem-solver with the vision to build from the ground up and the skill to own systems end-to-end. You'll thrive in our fast-paced environment by making tradeoffs and focusing on high-impact solutions. We're looking for someone who is as ambitious as we are to deliver high-quality products to our users. In short, we want owners who are ready to build big things with us.

As a Senior Platform Engineer (Infrastructure) at Ziina you will:

  • Build and own scalable, reliable infrastructure that supports high-performance applications across multiple regions

  • Own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines and release workflows so that shipping is fast, safe, and predictable

  • Implement infrastructure as code and automation across all environments to ensure consistency and reduce manual toil

  • Improve system observability, monitoring, and incident response so problems are caught early and resolved quickly

  • Reduce operational overhead and improve platform stability as we scale

  • Enable engineering teams through reliable, efficient platform systems and self-service tooling

To succeed in this role, you likely:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with a strong focus on infrastructure and developer experience

  • Have deep expertise with cloud services (ideally AWS) and infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi

  • Are proficient with containerization and orchestration — Docker, Kubernetes — and understand microservices architecture

  • Have hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, or similar)

  • Are comfortable with on-call responsibilities and have a track record of improving incident response practices

  • Use the latest AI tools and technologies to boost your productivity

  • Are based in, or open to relocating to, the UAE

What would amaze us:

  • Proven experience building infrastructure for fintech or other high-reliability, high-throughput platforms

  • A track record of tackling real scaling problems — reducing latency, improving resilience, or operating multi-region systems

  • History of building platform and developer experience tooling that measurably boosted engineering velocity

  • Successful leadership in major infrastructure evolution, including architectural transitions, migrations, or multi-region rollouts

  • Active engagement in the tech community through open source contributions, conference speaking, or technical writing

Our tech stack:

We’ve built a modular architecture with the principles of reliability, scalability, and maintainability in mind. Our current stack is:

  • Typescript, Node.js and Nest.js for our main application’s backend.

  • Swift/SwiftUI for our iOS app, Kotlin for our Android app.

  • Next.js, React and Typescript for our web applications.

  • GraphQL Federation for our client-facing APIs and Kafka for our inter-service communication.

  • PostgresSQL for consistent and durable storage, Redis for quick fetching, Elasticsearch for quick searching.

  • AWS for hosting our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes for orchestrating our workloads.

  • Terraform for IaC.

  • Github Actions for CI/CD.

This role is an exciting opportunity to shape the foundation that every Ziina engineer builds on: the infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability systems that keep our rapidly growing fintech platform fast, reliable, and easy to develop. We're at a major inflection point in our growth, with real multi-region and low-latency challenges at scale, and we're looking for the right person to drive the technical excellence that makes scaling possible.

As part of a small, agile team, our ideal candidate is a creative problem-solver with the vision to build from the ground up and the skill to own systems end-to-end. You'll thrive in our fast-paced environment by making tradeoffs and focusing on high-impact solutions. We're looking for someone who is as ambitious as we are to deliver high-quality products to our users. In short, we want owners who are ready to build big things with us.


AS A SENIOR PLATFORM ENGINEER (INFRASTRUCTURE) AT ZIINA YOU WILL:

 - Build and own scalable, reliable infrastructure that supports high-performance applications across multiple regions

 - Own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines and release workflows so that shipping is fast, safe, and predictable

 - Implement infrastructure as code and automation across all environments to ensure consistency and reduce manual toil

 - Improve system observability, monitoring, and incident response so problems are caught early and resolved quickly

 - Reduce operational overhead and improve platform stability as we scale

 - Enable engineering teams through reliable, efficient platform systems and self-service tooling


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE, YOU LIKELY:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with a strong focus on infrastructure and developer experience

 - Have deep expertise with cloud services (ideally AWS) and infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi

 - Are proficient with containerization and orchestration — Docker, Kubernetes — and understand microservices architecture

 - Have hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, or similar)

 - Are comfortable with on-call responsibilities and have a track record of improving incident response practices

 - Use the latest AI tools and technologies to boost your productivity

 - Are based in, or open to relocating to, the UAE


WHAT WOULD AMAZE US:

 - Proven experience building infrastructure for fintech or other high-reliability, high-throughput platforms

 - A track record of tackling real scaling problems — reducing latency, improving resilience, or operating multi-region systems

 - History of building platform and developer experience tooling that measurably boosted engineering velocity

 - Successful leadership in major infrastructure evolution, including architectural transitions, migrations, or multi-region rollouts

 - Active engagement in the tech community through open source contributions, conference speaking, or technical writing


OUR TECH STACK:

We’ve built a modular architecture with the principles of reliability, scalability, and maintainability in mind. Our current stack is:

 - Typescript, Node.js and Nest.js for our main application’s backend.

 - Swift/SwiftUI for our iOS app, Kotlin for our Android app.

 - Next.js, React and Typescript for our web applications.

 - GraphQL Federation for our client-facing APIs and Kafka for our inter-service communication.

 - PostgresSQL for consistent and durable storage, Redis for quick fetching, Elasticsearch for quick searching.

 - AWS for hosting our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes for orchestrating our workloads.

 - Terraform for IaC.

 - Github Actions for CI/CD.

jobs.title: Senior Content Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

We're looking for a Senior Content Designer to be the architect of Ziina's product voice — the person who shapes how we communicate at every touchpoint where language makes or breaks the experience.

You'll sit inside Product & Design, embedded from the moment ideas take shape, not brought in to polish copy at the end. As our first dedicated content hire, you'll set the foundation others build on: the voice, the principles, the terminology, the standards. UX writing is your primary craft, but this role demands range, moving across product copy, onboarding flows, and voice and tone guidelines, and leaning into brand and marketing writing when required.

This is about more than writing. It's about owning the full content lifecycle: from establishing terminology frameworks, to shipping copy that makes financial tasks feel effortless, to creating support responses that hold trust in high-stakes moments.

 

As a Senior Content Designer at Ziina, you will:

  • Own and write all in-product copy, including error states, empty states, onboarding flows, confirmation screens, transactional and lifecycle emails, push notifications, help center content, and support macros, extending to web copy and lifecycle communications when needed.

  • Partner closely with Product & Design teams, working in Figma to shape user flows, contribute to information architecture, and prototype content early in the design process.

  • Define and evolve Ziina’s voice and tone guidelines, including terminology frameworks, naming conventions, and content principles that scale across teams.

  • Establish and maintain a cohesive content system that ensures consistency and clarity across all product and communication surfaces.

  • Use A/B testing, usability insights, and conversion data to iterate on messaging and continuously improve content performance.

  • Support brand and marketing efforts by contributing to campaign messaging and ensuring consistency of voice across all channels.

  • Build and own AI-assisted content workflows, including prompt libraries and tooling that enable the team to scale high-quality content creation efficiently.

 

To succeed in this role, you likely:

  • Have 4+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or content strategy, ideally embedded within product or design teams at a fast-scaling company.

  • Have built and implemented content systems such as voice and tone guidelines, terminology frameworks, or component libraries that extend beyond your individual contributions.

  • Bring strong UX writing skills, with experience across a range of content types, including exposure to brand or marketing writing.

  • Work confidently in design tools like Figma, contributing directly to product flows, annotations, and design critiques.

  • Demonstrate strong product thinking and an understanding of information architecture, with the ability to identify structural and content gaps in user experiences.

  • Operate with high ownership and organization, managing competing priorities while delivering quality work on time.

  • Are comfortable using data and research to inform content decisions and improve user outcomes.

  • Are based in, or open to relocating to the UAE

What would amaze us:

  • You’ve been the first or early content hire and have built a content function or system from scratch.

  • You’ve worked on fintech, payments, or other high-trust products where clarity and tone are critical.

  • You’ve demonstrated measurable impact through content decisions, backed by experimentation or user insights.

  • You’ve developed scalable AI-assisted content workflows or tooling that improved team efficiency.

  • You bring a strong portfolio that showcases product copy in context, along with the thinking, systems, and data behind your decisions.

 

A portfolio is required. We want to see product copy in context, not just the final words, but the thinking behind them. Show us a content system or set of guidelines you've built, and at least one example where your writing decisions were shaped by user research or data.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Internal Tools)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

Ziina is looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join our Platform team and help build the internal tools that power our operations.

You will improve and extend the tools our teams use today while helping us gradually bring our back-office platform in-house. This includes understanding complex operational processes, integrating with our existing third-party solution, and building intuitive workflows that enable teams to operate safely and efficiently.

As our team is small, our ideal candidate is a creative thinker who enjoys understanding how a business operates and translating ambiguous requirements into reliable software. They can move quickly, clearly articulate tradeoffs, and independently own features from discovery through production.

We are ambitious about building internal platforms that scale with the company, and we’d love to bring on someone who shares that ambition.

As a Full-Stack Engineer on the Platform team at Ziina, you will:

  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, risk, customer support, product, and engineering teams to understand workflows and identify opportunities for better tooling and automation.

  • Improve and extend the workflows supported by our existing third-party back-office solution, including building the integrations and supporting services it requires.

  • Help define and incrementally build Ziina’s in-house back-office platform, taking features from discovery and design through implementation, rollout, and iteration.

  • Turn complex operational processes into intuitive and reliable experiences with appropriate permissions, safeguards, and auditability.

  • Establish consistent patterns for internal interfaces and service integrations, while ensuring critical workflows are tested, monitored, and resilient to failure.

To succeed in this role, you likely:

  • Have 4+ years of full-stack development experience and are comfortable working across web applications, APIs, backend services, and relational databases.

  • Enjoy understanding operational workflows and solving problems for internal users.

  • Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous requirements and can independently drive work forward.

  • Balance delivery speed with security, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical collaborators and demonstrate high integrity and a team-first mindset.

  • Are based in, or open to relocating to, the UAE.

What would amaze us

  • Deep proficiency with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, with strong experience building backend services using Node.js and Nest.js.

  • Experience building internal tools, administrative platforms, operational dashboards, or workflow-management systems.

  • Experience designing permissions, approval workflows, audit logs, and other controls for sensitive operations.

  • Experience with GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and event-driven or asynchronous workflows.

  • An AI-forward mindset, with experience using AI-assisted development tools and applying AI to simplify or automate operational workflows.

Our tech stack

We’ve built a modular architecture with reliability, scalability, and maintainability in mind. Our current stack is:

  • TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js, Next.js, and React.

  • GraphQL Federation and Kafka.

  • PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch.

  • AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

  • GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
